confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Hue, a mid-sized Vietnamese tourist city that is cheaper than Da Nang or Hoi An. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and local-meal anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because accommodation prices vary widely by district, season and booking channel. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker. July is peak season in central Vietnam, so accommodation may run above the off-season level.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: central Vietnam tourist cities (Da Nang, Hoi An, Nha Trang) adjusted down for Hue's lower tourist density and cheaper local food and lodging. Beer, coffee and meal anchors follow Vietnamese restaurant and cafe price levels. Hotel and hostel anchors follow guesthouse and budget hotel pricing in mid-sized Vietnamese tourist towns.
